items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview, 1961-02-02
items.q: I first started using this beat when I was playing with Sidney Dees Vee in the band, around 1932 to 33.

ctx.x: Did you have any special beat?

No, just that beat I followed behind. That same beat I used to follow. And I changed that beat from that beat. This was my beat. Yeah. When I changed this beat, then I started following way back in the, I mean in later years, around in the late 30s. Yeah. That's why I started using this beat. It's called drag, thrush roll. Yeah. You know, like 30s. I first started using this beat when I was playing with Sidney Dees Vee in the band, around 1932 to 33. I called it the swing band. You know what I called it? It's…
I changed the band. You see. That was the style I played.
